appearance: Dry bright daylight, rolling grassy horizon.
layout_year: Modern simulator/mod with2024styleFerrari; exactyear unknown. Camera/replaycuts are not metric track evidence.

origin.meaning: Local source origin at the point on the loop nearest the venue coordinate, after rotation to the start.

native_station_frame.side_convention: Driver left/right in forward lap direction; geographic footprints retain source east/north coordinates.

review.method: Viewed every frame of overview and detail contact sheets. Sparse review of edited gameplay; rear cameras, menus and cuts are excluded as metric geometry evidence.

sectors.name: Pitstraight, downhillT1 and uphillT2
sectors.observed: Long grandstand opposite the pit complex. The broad left T1 entry descends sharply, with gravel outside and a red-white inside kerb. The road climbs toward T2. Grass banks and distant protection should preserve these changing sightlines.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T3–5 hillside changes
sectors.observed: Green and brown grass slopes, low broadleaf tree groups, and broad grass or gravel escape areas. Kerbs have green painted outer strips. The linked corners rise and fall with the hills, with Armco and mesh behind the escape areas.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T6–7 descent
sectors.observed: A fast descent leads to a right corner. The grass bank sets a high horizon, with a distant stand above the barrier. Broad red-white kerbs, green paint and light gravel frame the braking zone.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T8 multi-apexleft
sectors.observed: The long multi-apex left follows an open hillside. A red-white inside kerb connects the apexes; wide gravel and a grass bank sit outside. Keep the outside protection curved and behind the escape area.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T9–10 shortcomplex
sectors.observed: Downhill braking followed by a left-right change. There are broad green painted aprons, dry grass banks, small marshal posts and distant stands. The reference shows a tall arched crossing nearby; its exact position needs separate registration.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T11 fastkink and longstraight
sectors.observed: An undulating straight and fast kink have broad grass verges and Armco set back from the road. The hill partly hides the horizon. Paddock buildings and a large roof stand appear on the approach, with distance boards before T12.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T12–14 finalslowcomplex
sectors.observed: Tight left-right-left corners sit beside the pit and main stand. Paved and gravel escape areas surround the red-white kerbs and green paint. The control and hospitality buildings have angular stacked roofs and recessed glazing.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Finalexit toSF
sectors.observed: The wide final exit joins the pit straight. A roofed crowd stand faces white garage fronts and projecting slabs. Grid marks and a fenced pit wall define the straight; grass embankments remain visible behind the facilities.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

uncertainties: Direct bilinear GLO-30 samples replace the former GLO-90 driving profile. The bounded 40.34 m relief puts the main crest near T3; this remains a 30 m surface model rather than surveyed road levels.
The operator reports about 60 m relief, which conflicts with the retained DEMs. No arbitrary height multiplier is applied; the source conflict is retained in elevation-research.json.
The native width range now follows published 14.5–21 m controls. A newer operator diagram reports 21.5 m maximum; exact local width transitions remain estimates.
